title: Completed-Loan Rate Reduction on Kestrel Advantage Balloon Refinances
content:
**Relationship pricing — completed loans.** A customer refinancing the balloon of a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract who has completed earlier Kestrel loans has the refinance APR reduced. The lines counted are the **Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract** and the **Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**; a line counts when the customer has an account in it at paid in full or closed.

| Lines with an account at paid in full or closed | Reduction of the refinance APR |
|---|---|
| Both the new-vehicle retail and the pre-owned retail lines | 0.25 percentage points |
| Exactly one of those lines | 0.15 percentage points |
| Neither | None |

The records read are the status of the customer's new-vehicle retail contracts and pre-owned retail contracts. Leases do not enter this reduction, and two completed contracts in the same line count as one line.

*Hypothetical:* a closed pre-owned retail contract and an active new-vehicle retail contract: one line, 0.15 percentage points.
